auditor_role: Principal ML Research Scientist & Dataset Forensics Specialist

primary_resumematch_corpus.license: Unspecified on Hugging Face (community research usage; potential privacy/PII constraint)
primary_resumematch_corpus.label_provenance: Recruiter/expert manual judgment on three-tier suitability scale.
primary_resumematch_corpus.label_nature: Manual ordinal assessment of qualification alignment.
data_quality_issues: 6 known exact-pair label contradictions in raw data (e.g. identical resume-job pair labeled both 'No Fit' and 'Good Fit').
Inter-annotator agreement ceiling estimated at 70%-75% for 3-class fit.
Severe entity sparsity: 643 resumes and 351 jobs across 8,000 pairs (mean ~12 pairs/resume, ~23 pairs/job).

labels.description: Job skill tags extracted across 5 job categories (Business Dev, Finance, Sales, HR, IT)

secondary_job_skill_set.label_provenance: Rule-based and NER-extracted skill taxonomies from job descriptions.
secondary_job_skill_set.label_nature: Entity extraction annotations (NOT candidate-job fit matches).
secondary_job_skill_set.status: AUXILIARY_DICTIONARY (Used for SkillEngine vocabulary and domain feature expansion)

external_djinni_corpus.source_url: ACL 2024 (Koshkin et al., 'Introducing the Djinni Recruitment Dataset')
external_djinni_corpus.license: MIT License / Open Data Commons Attribution (ODC-By)
external_djinni_corpus.label_provenance: None. Tables share zero common candidate/job foreign keys, application IDs, or recruiter feedback.
external_djinni_corpus.label_nature: Unlabelled candidate profiles and unlabelled job postings.
external_djinni_corpus.status: UNSUPERVISED_ONLY (Permitted for domain adaptation and proposal generation; PROHIBITED from synthetic ground-truth benchmarking)
